name: Creative & Offer
focus: Multi-SKU merchandising, offer architecture and conversion creative
summary: Material shift: move from one-product merchandising to three job-led collections. Keep Kit Muda Cero as HERO, elevate only differentiated hard-bottom dog-car cover as second HERO candidate, and keep packing cubes/sunshade as TEST until economics support them. Muda Cero first price test moves to €39.90, then €34.90.
blocker: Final pricing still depends on Finance and verified landed cost.

store_builder: Build navigation around three job-led collections, not supplier categories.
Use real looping video in hero and collection headers; 3D only as secondary fit/construction explainer.
Add compatibility/fit modules to Muda Cero, dog-cover and sunshade PDPs.
Prepare data-driven bundle and cross-sell components.
seo_catalog: Cluster around pet hair removal/dog grooming at home; dog car protection/pet travel; packing organization/windshield sun protection.
Build FAQs around coat type, textile compatibility, vehicle measurements, waterproofing, wash care, compression and windshield sizing.
Do not index thin TEST pages until product data and useful copy are complete.

events.title: Portfolio architecture changed
events.detail: Creative moved from one-product merchandising to three adjacent job-led collections so the store can scale toward 20–50 SKUs without looking like a bazaar.

events.title: Muda Cero pricing order changed
events.detail: Competitor benchmarks support testing €39.90 first, €34.90 second; €29.90 remains acquisition-only pending Finance.

events.title: Second HERO narrowed
events.detail: Generic dog hammocks are rejected; only a hard-bottom/backseat-extender version should advance as a HERO candidate.
